name: Fast Dual Contouring
definition: A dual contouring algorithm implemented in C++ that generates a mesh from a voxel grid by finding intersections on edges, computing vertex positions via QEF (Quadratic Error Function) minimization, and simplifying the resulting mesh.
summary: Fast Dual Contouring extracts manifold meshes from voxel grids by optimizing grid traversal and QEF assembly for real-time performance and sharper feature preservation.
